requirements.statement: Final project deliverables, record models, as-built documentation, and decision evidence shall be archived in the governed records/archive location.
The archive shall be locked against modification except for designated archive administrators adding governed post-handover records.
Archived records are immutable; post-archive changes require versioned addenda with a new evidence trail.
Project closeout shall produce an export package containing as-built models, record drawings, O&M documentation, final coordination/QA reports, and decision evidence.
